discoveries.title: A day on Mars is just 37 minutes longer than on Earth.
discoveries.body: One Martian day, called a sol, lasts about 24 hours and 39 minutes.

discoveries.title: Sunsets on Mars appear blue.
discoveries.body: Fine dust particles in the thin Martian atmosphere scatter blue light forward toward an observer.

quiz.question: What is the name of the largest volcano in the solar system, located on Mars?
quiz.explanation: Olympus Mons is a massive shield volcano nearly 22 km (13.6 mi) high, about two and a half times Mount Everest's height!
